chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Zurara, from one of the two Imams (peace be upon them), who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Adhere to the milk of the cow, for it mingles with every tree.'
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of drinking cow's milk in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from al-Kafi, the Prophet (peace be upon him) recommends cow's milk for its purity, noting that it is mixed with all types of trees (or all things), reflecting the Shia scholarly view of its universal wholesomeness. This narration is often cited in discussions on dietary laws (fiqh al-ghidha') to highlight the natural purity of dairy products in Islamic tradition. The emphasis on 'mixing with all trees' underscores the idea that cow's milk absorbs the essence of diverse vegetation, making it a comprehensive and balanced food source.
